blockers: No active Assist request where helperRole=deep-resolver.
No role cycle requires Resolver cycle-breaking.

learning.lesson: Do not convert a bounded independently-actionable label into permission for repeated research when the same Resolver item already has an awaiting_new_evidence disposition and its input has not materially changed.
learning.repeatedBlocker: unchanged Resolver contradiction plus incomplete Alpha-owned source-integrity/company-underwriting evidence
learning.failedStrategy: re-inspecting unchanged contradiction evidence before root-owner inputs change
learning.changedStrategy: defer unchanged adjudicated Resolver work and preserve capacity for a changed input signature, genuine new contradiction, or explicit Resolver assist
learning.successSignal: a materially changed contradiction packet, active genuine Resolver assist, or cycle/deadlock requiring bounded adjudication

authorityBoundary: No canonical methodology, score, rank, tick, membership, underwriting value, automation definition, or Chief decision was modified.
